title: Photography
text:
As a wizard and scholar of Middle-earth, I have been studying the magic of the natural world for centuries. Through my self-portraits, I aim to capture the essence of my own being and reflect on my own journey through time. Each photograph is a reflection of my own experiences and emotions. Through my photography, I hope to offer a glimpse into my life as a scholar and adventurer, and inspire others to reflect on their own journeys through the world.

title: Projects
text:
I am an Undergraduate and Graduate Student at Case Western Reserve University obtaining a B.S. in Neuroscience with Computer Science and Chemistry Minors and a Biomedical and Health Informatics M.S. with an expected graduation date of May 2028. I am proficient in Java, MATLAB, and Python and I have experience in C++, HTML, and R. I am currently working in the Dawn Taylor Lab at the Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute as an Undergraduate Research Student in which I utilize MATLAB to write custom scripts to synthesize Dr. Taylor’s EEG data. Additionally as a part of this lab I am coding an app through MATLAB’s App Developer that will be able to take in any EEG data and remove the unwanted peaks and save the data as a new file. Concurrently I am the Software Engineer for the project Mind Mouse, a BCI-controlled computer mouse that will be able to move and perform left and right clicks based on the users intention. This project is still in the early stages of development through the neurotechnology club, NeurEx, at Case Western Reserve University.
